HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 1
Amended and Restated Certificate of Incorporation of Harbor Labs, Inc., filed June
21, 2011
Authorized stock: 6,000,000 shares of common stock and 1,000,000 shares of preferred
stock, all designated Series Seed Preferred.
Original issue price of the Series Seed Preferred: $3.75 per share.
Liquidation preference: one times the original issue price, then the remaining
assets go to the common stock.
Each share of Series Seed Preferred converts into one share of common stock at the
holder's option.
